title: Edging options for the gravel path
summary: Three ways to keep the gravel from spreading onto the beds, put forward for picking.

# Edging options for the gravel path

Gravel keeps drifting onto the bed edges after rain. One option is a row of
bricks set on end, which is quick and cheap. Another is a strip of treated
board pegged along the path, which looks tidier but will rot in a few years.
A third is a shallow trench filled with larger stones, which drains well and
lasts longest but takes the most digging and a few full wheelbarrow loads.
